crossRefs.note: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and…
Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.
Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They…
He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.
Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around…
The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings…
to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then…

people.name: Gaza

people.name: Tiphsah
people.line: City on the Euphrates, extent of Solomon's kingdom

translations.web: For he had dominion over all on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides around him.
translations.bsb: For Solomon had dominion over everything west of the Euphrates —over all the kingdoms from Tiphsah to Gaza—and he had peace on all sides.
translations.kjv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
translations.asv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
